documents.title: BackgroundFetchRegistration: abort() method
documents.summary: The abort() method of the BackgroundFetchRegistration interface aborts an active background fetch.

body:
The <mark>abort</mark>() method of the Background<mark>Fetch</mark>Registration interface aborts an active background <mark>fetch</mark>.
jsabort()
None.
A Promise that resolves with true if the <mark>fetch</mark> is successfully aborted.

Use <mark>abort</mark>() to terminate a background <mark>fetch</mark> that is in progress.
jsbg<mark>Fetch.abort</mark>();

documents.title: AbortController: abort() method
documents.summary:
The abort() method of the AbortController interface aborts an asynchronous operation before it has completed.
This is able to abort fetch requests, the consumption of any response bodies, or streams.

body: The <mark>abort</mark>() method of the <mark>Abort</mark>Controller interface aborts an asynchronous operation before it has completed.
